data.gender_notes: Mridul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who delights, charms and enchants others with their intelligence and knowledge. The name Mridul carries the meaning “Delight, Charm, Enchant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Mridul usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, charm, enchant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
